note: Wooded family campground just south of Allen Lake, with a fishing pier on the lake and swimming at the Hartman Lake beach, a short walk east. The Ice Age Trail and mountain-bike trails pass close by. --Claude
summary: DNR camping page, campground map, summer park map, closures feed, OSM and imagery read; GoingToCamp refuses (fees $23-40 unconfirmed). 103 sites, 26 public electric (+ host 23E); two shower/flush buildings, vault, water, dump. Season Apr 2-Nov 30 (stored 04-01 -> 04-02). PIN WRONG by ~900 m: stored point is the Horse Trail Parking loop by Hartman Lake. Electric 50A stored with no source. Not waterfront confirmed.
flags: PIN MOVE (~900 m): stored 44.3220,-89.2090 is the small loop of service roads south of E. Windfelt Lane by Hartman Lake (the summer map's Horse Trail Parking), not the campground; the stored waterfront_evidence's 'actual campground ... at 44.322,-89.209' was this same mistake. Target: 44.3243,-89.2200 (middle of the family campground loops, beside the shower building OSM 44.32457,-89.22037; loops span ~44.3232-44.3255, -89.2236 to -89.2162 per OSM ways 549264101/1087922017). The loops are under continuous canopy on imagery.
HOOKUPS: stored electric 50 (derived from the note's '15/30/50A') has no source on the DNR pages or map; GoingToCamp refuses. Left as is; unsourced.

SITES: 103 confirmed; electric sites 21E, 47E, 65E-87E, 103E (26 public) plus host 23E. The stored note's horse-area remark is dropped: the park has horse trails and a Horse Trail Parking lot east by Hartman Lake but no horse camp; nothing horse-related in the family campground.
SEASON: 04-01 -> 04-02 (DNR: 'From Dec. 1 through April 1 both the family and group campgrounds are closed'); closes 11-30 kept.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed. Allen Lake is about 100 m north of the north tip (sites 28-32) through continuous forest; no site has open ground to the shore. Esri imagery and campground map.
FEES: $23-40 from the 2026-10-10 GoingToCamp capture; unconfirmed today (403).
PHONE 715-258-2372 confirmed on the park page. WEBSITE: https://dnr.wisconsin.gov/topic/parks/hartmancreek live; GoingToCamp link kept.
Policy row state:WI: nothing contradicts it.
